VIKRAM RAO
Staff Engineer · Hyderabad, India
vikram.rao.eng@example.com · +91 90000 45678 · github.com/vikramrao · linkedin.com/in/vikram-rao-eng

SUMMARY
Staff engineer with 11 years of experience building high-throughput backend platforms in logistics and payments. I
like boring, correct systems: idempotent writes, sharding without downtime and a quiet pager.

EXPERIENCE

Parcelwise — Staff Engineer                                                       Hyderabad · Apr 2021 – Present
Logistics platform. Go services on Kubernetes, PostgreSQL on AWS.
- Lead the routing platform team of 9 (Go, gRPC, Kubernetes).
- Cut p99 route-quote latency from 820 ms to 140 ms (Redis caching, query tuning, load tests before every release).
- Moved the shipment ledger (2.1 billion rows) from a single Postgres to a sharded cluster with no downtime.
- Run the weekly architecture review and mentor engineers on the routing team.

Finmint — Senior Software Engineer                                               Bengaluru · Jul 2017 – Mar 2021
Payments company (PCI DSS scope).
- Built the idempotent payout service handling ₹1,200 crore a month; payout events flow through Kafka.
- On-call lead for 2 years at 99.99% monthly availability.

ShopLane — Software Engineer                                                     Bengaluru · Jun 2014 – Jun 2017
E-commerce company.
- Built the search indexing pipeline in Java and Elasticsearch; cut catalog reindex time from 6 hours to 40 minutes.

Infosys — Associate Engineer                                                        Mysuru · Aug 2013 – May 2014

OPEN SOURCE
- Contributor to pgshard (12 merged PRs).

TALKS
- "Sharding without tears" — GopherCon India 2024
- "Idempotency at ₹1,200 crore a month" — Rootconf 2022

EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science — NIT Karnataka (Surathkal)                                                    2009 – 2013

SKILLS
Languages: Go, Java, SQL, Bash
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch
Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS (RDS, EKS, S3)
Reliability: SLOs, incident response, load testing
Security: auth and secrets management, threat modelling, PCI DSS
Leadership: technical strategy, mentoring, architecture review

sources.content:
# Talks: Vikram Rao

## Conference talks (2)

### 1. "Sharding without tears" — GopherCon India 2024
Format: conference talk
Abstract: How Parcelwise moved a shipment ledger of 2.1 billion rows from a single Postgres to a sharded cluster with no
downtime: dual writes, backfill, shadow reads and the cutover checklist.

### 2. "Idempotency at ₹1,200 crore a month" — Rootconf 2022
Format: conference talk
Abstract: Design of an idempotent payout service: idempotency keys, retry safety, ledger reconciliation and what to do when a
downstream bank times out.

## Observations
- Both talks are about systems he led or built, and each states the scale up front.
- Slides and demo code are in the talks repository on GitHub; no recordings are linked.
